commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' 3 - 1 Goal! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) takes a short pass from Alejandro Balde in his stride in the box, jinks inside his man and unleashes an unstoppable shot inside the right post. 3:1.
90+5' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
90+5' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Good work from Atl. Madrid as they win a corner.
90+4' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona).

90+3' Nice individual effort by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out. Barcelona get a corner.
90+3' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the right post.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

90' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) wastes no time in going for goal after collecting a rebound, but his long-range effort is comfortably blocked by a defender. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' Substitution. Lamine Yamal will be replaced by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona).

77' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempts to find a teammate with the corner, but the effort is snuffed out by the goalkeeper.
